the tenant issuer (the API validates id_token iss against AUTH_ISSUER)
and the poker_equity application — same client id as prod so the code's
AUTH_CLIENT_ID default works. The OAuth client secret, the two user
passwords, the JWT signing key id and the kickstart API key are NOT in
this file: local-stack.sh generates them into
containers/simulationAPI/.env.local (gitignored) and passes them to the
read below via #{ENV.…}. Everything else here is
The tenant theme (auto dark mode, same CSS as prod's
containers/fusionAuth/kickstart.json - keep in sync) is duplicated from
the default theme, then given the stylesheet: a POST with sourceThemeId
ignores every other theme field, so the stylesheet is a second PATCH.
